title: RunController fixed-timestep accumulator (AC-E21 clamp + slow-mo) has no test — an explicitly-pinned headless contract
evidence:
run_controller.gd header + const:
## _process: clamp delta ([FinLT]), step the sim N times to catch up, capped to
## avoid spiral-of-death. Slow-mo: if it can't keep up it falls behind (never
## skips ticks, AC-E21).
const MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME: int = 5      # catch-up cap; excess carries (slow-mo, AC-E21)

run_controller.gd _process:
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if paused or state == null:
		return
	delta = minf(delta, CoreConst.MAX_FRAME_DELTA) * time_scale   # [FinLT] clamp
	accumulator += delta
	var steps: int = 0
	while accumulator >= tick_len and steps < MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME:
		_do_step()
		accumulator -= tick_len
		steps += 1
	# slow-mo: if still behind after the cap, drop excess so accumulator can't
	# grow unbounded (the sim simply runs slow — AC-E21: never skips ticks).
	if accumulator > tick_len * float(MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME):
		accumulator = tick_len * float(MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME)

Pinned contract (sprint-plan-v1.md, S0.1 test contracts): "accumulator clamps delta; slow-mo never skips ticks [AC-E21]"; S0 exit criteria: "Sim slow-mo never skips ticks [AC-E21]".
No test: grep RunController/accumulator/_process/MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME across game/tests/ = no matches; run_tests.gd registers 8 suites, all in tests/core/ (none touch the run layer).
detail: S0.1 pins 'accumulator clamps delta; slow-mo never skips ticks [AC-E21]' as a headless contract. The clamp, catch-up cap, and slow-mo branch are logic, but no test exercises them — a pacing regression (dropping ticks under a stall) ships silently.
recommended_fix: Extract the accumulator math into a pure helper (or drive it via a scene test) and assert: delta clamped to MAX_FRAME_DELTA; ≤MAX_STEPS_PER_FRAME catch-up steps/frame; a large stall caps the accumulator (slow-mo) while every tick still runs in order.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
